title: Market-signal cohort analysis: model switching & attrition triggers
creator: Priya Narang
description: Synthesize a repeatable research playbook to identify why customers switch model providers or downgrade model tiers. Produce cohort-based signals and actionable competitive watch alerts that feed the Model Landscape Signals backlog. Focus on leading indicators (latency regressions, token-cost anomalies, API errors, quality drift on key prompts) and behavioral signals (usage drop by route, increased retrying, feature disablement).
acceptance_criteria: Draft research plan validated by PM lead and Research Ops
Cohort segmentation implemented against production telemetry (at least 3 cohort definitions)
Top 5 attrition triggers quantified with effect sizes and examples
Deliverable deck and 10 prioritized watch alerts created and uploaded to shared drive
Hand-off artifact for ENG/Console with recommended instrumentation changes
tasks: Align on primary business questions with Growth and Sales (kickoff)
Define cohort definitions: trial->paid churners, committed-downgrade, high-latency switchers
Query telemetry for 90-day window: token usage, latency P50/P95, error-rate, retry-rates
Link contract cancellation notes and support tickets to telemetry records
Run manual qualitative sample of 30 churn cases (support threads + win/loss calls)
Estimate measurable thresholds for flags (e.g., 2x spike in P95 latency over baseline)
Create watch-alert templates and integrate with SignalOps backlog
data_sources: Redwood Console telemetry (per-route token & latency metrics)
Support ticket DB and CS notes
Third-party competitor monitoring feeds (public pricing changes, infra outages)
hypotheses: H1: Short-term latency regressions (>=2x P95 for >1 hour) correlate with a >15% immediate drop in traffic and 8% 30-day churn among affected customers
H2: Sudden per-token price reductions by competitors cause low-volume, cost-sensitive customers to trial alternative providers within 14 days
H3: Feature gaps (e.g., lack of function calling, streaming) drive switching for real-time product cohorts even when raw latency and cost are comparable
H4: Unclear versioning and rollback behaviors increase engineering friction and raise model-deployment churn for platform teams
deliverables: Research playbook (PDF) with cohort definitions and query templates
Deck summarizing top attrition triggers, effect sizes, and prioritized mitigations
10 watch-alert rules (text) for Model Landscape Signals backlog
Instrumentation spec PR for ENG to add correlation keys between billing, telemetry, and support
Sample customer narratives for Product & Sales enablement
timeline: Week 1: Kickoff, finalize cohorts, data access requests
Week 2: Telemetry queries + link with billing/support, run initial analytics
Week 3: Qualitative interviews and manual case reviews
Week 4: Synthesize findings, build alerts, review with stakeholders
Week 5: Deliver final deck, handoff instrumentation PRs and runbook
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Incomplete linkage between billing and telemetry will reduce signal accuracy; Mitigation: add correlation_key to telemetry and backfill mapping where possible
Risk: Small sample size for churn cases in niche verticals; Mitigation: broaden time window and include qualitative interviews
Risk: Competitive pricing moves are noisy and short-lived; Mitigation: prioritize sustained price changes (>30 days) and corroborate with customer feedback
next_steps: Schedule 60-minute kickoff with Growth, Sales, Research Ops (by 2025-11-14)
Open data access ticket with ENG telemetry (ENG-21109) and track as dependency
Draft initial SQL templates and share with Research Ops for review
Recruit 12 customers for quick interview sampling (CS + Sales to assist)
